label: No component of anything is the first being: no part of a composite…, by Potency or participation…
meaning: ST I q.3 a.8's third reason, typed. Every component is in potency in some respect or participated (STMT-COMPONENT-IS-POTENTIAL-OR-PARTICIPATED). If in potency, act is simply prior to potency (STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY), so something in act in that respect is prior to it; if the component were first, that prior thing would be the component itself, in act and in potency in one respect, against STMT-NOTHING-IN-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT. If participated, it has a distinct cause of its being (STMT-PARTICIPATED-HAS-OTHER-CAUSE), which as efficient cause is prior to it (STMT-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-IS-PRIOR-TO-EFFECT), against firstness. Derives STMT-NO-COMPONENT-IS-FIRST-BEING, an underived leaf of 21 root routes, with two of its five premises already on those routes. The same InPotency parameter is used in act priority and in the same-respect exclusion, and the same CausesIn in the participation and efficient-priority premises, so each pair must be read in one sense (DISAMB-POTENCY, DISAMB-PRIORITY-SIMPLE-OR-IN-TIME). All five premises stay open.
